dashboard.title: RabbitMQ
dashboard.description: Monitor RabbitMQ queues: unroutable messages, queue backlog, unacknowledged messages, consumer counts, and message throughput.

visuals.title: Messages dropped
visuals.description: Messages discarded as unroutable, because no queue was bound to match their routing key. Any value here is lost work: check that the publisher's routing key matches an existing binding.

visuals.title: Messages ready
visuals.description: Messages sitting in the queue waiting for a consumer. A backlog that grows without returning to zero means producers are outpacing consumers and you need more workers or faster ones.

visuals.title: Messages unacknowledged
visuals.description: Messages delivered to a consumer that have not been acknowledged yet. A count that climbs and stays high means consumers are accepting work they never finish, usually a slow handler or a worker that died holding messages.

visuals.title: Consumers
visuals.description: Consumers currently reading from each queue. A queue holding messages with zero consumers is stalled, and is the first thing to check when work stops being processed.

visuals.title: Message throughput
visuals.description: Messages published into each queue, delivered to consumers, and acknowledged by them. Publishing consistently above delivery is what produces a growing backlog; delivery above acknowledgement means consumers are falling behind on work they already accepted.
